create_meta_selfplay_agent: create a MetaSelfplayAgent with repeats, training_epochs, and a data_loader for RNN meta-regret matching self-play
train_meta_selfplay_agent: train a MetaSelfplayAgent by calling train() to run the training optimizer and initialize regret sums
build_optimizer_model: build an OptimizerModel with a learning rate and call get_optimizer_model() to initialize JAX network parameters and optimizer state
get_initial_policy: get the initial policy from a trained MetaSelfplayAgent by calling initial_policy() to return a softmax strategy
compute_next_policy: compute the next policy from a MetaSelfplayAgent by calling next_policy(last_values) to update regret sums and return updated softmax strategy
